title: Tornado Warning

* Tornado Warning for...
Central Hart County in central Kentucky...
Southeastern Grayson County in central Kentucky...
Northeastern Edmonson County in south central Kentucky...

* Until 500 PM CDT.

30 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed.
Damage to roofs, windows, and vehicles will occur.  Tree
damage is likely.

* This dangerous storm will be near...
Munfordville around 440 PM CDT.

Other locations impacted by this tornadic thunderstorm include Rock
Creek, Wabash, Bonnieville, Cub Run, Logsdon Valley, Lines Mill,
Broad Ford, Peonia, Pearman, and Snap.
details.instruction:
TAKE COVER NOW! Move to a basement or an interior room on the lowest
floor of a sturdy building. Avoid windows. If you are outdoors, in a
mobile home, or in a vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter
and protect yourself from flying debris.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with this storm, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Liberty, Damascus, Callicoon, Cochecton, Jeffersonville, White

a line extending from near Salina to near Annabella. Movement was
northwest at 15 mph.

unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Richfield, Salina, Annabella, Centerfield, Aurora, Redmond, Glenwood,
Sigurd, and Axtell.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 70 between mile markers 34 and 67.
US Route 50 between mile markers 141 and 158.
US Route 89 between mile markers 226 and 238.
Utah Route 24 between mile markers 16 and 19.
details.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.
